rationale.provenance-auditability: Proposes verifiable provenance tracing for artifacts assembled by AI agents.
rationale.intro-framing: Names the gap but does not operationalize a mechanism.
rationale.agentic: Focuses on AI agents assembling software at artifact granularity.
rationale.steering: Solution operates on generation by restricting AI to certified modules.
